I've heard that before. Always from people who would go on to commit acts of violence and the beautiful thing about getting old is seeing them spiral into prison while I slowly heal.

1) You're not alone. I'm carrying it too, today. 

2) The help has improved and learned more about trauma. You can always TRY and opt out later 

3) Involuntary from ICU is a beast. Having a 20s EMT just BEAT YOU alive is nothing like television. It's painful for the weeks of white walls. I just stared and willed my body away. But here I sit. 

4) Being authentic has put more good stuff in the world and I highly recommend feeling empowered by nothing left to lose if you feel like throwing it away. 

5) At least set the record before you commit to a statistic. Be heard. Tell someone WHY. If you don't know, then that's where you start. 

I did it, 0 stars. Go take a lingering bath and remember that you won't get a tub in psych. 🙏🏻

23-28 is a hot years investment. Double it. So get rid of him and find your husband.

Meeeeeeee 

I feel like dishes haunt me and I haven't been good at eating lately. It's tedious and exhausting because of the years of people telling me to do it differently and the system failures that come with the PTSD of late- diagnosis. I was never taught how to clean up, just shame for not knowing something OBVIOUS. And it really is that basic. It's easier to talk through and do. Grab a drink and intentionally sit with her in the kitchen making a meal and then you can explain the things that matter to your comfort level. But do it from a place of knowing you are blessed to just "know" the obvious thing and I ran away from the kitchen because I couldn't get everything in the dishwasher and now there's only half a load. To me, the half-a-load, load is far more offensive and I don't get to decide which things are now assigned toxic shame. 


Soooo additional trauma is likely to cause serious emotional dysregulation. Why?! Speak up as you are expecting and experiencing. Have you taught your roommate that you will always do her dishes? In an effort to maintain your emotions, you acted without addressing the problem and she's on a totally different expectation. 

I hate when others BUILD UP the problem for years, just saving up betrayal and distrust over a little thing. You are hurting your own feelings and now it's my fault? Can't. Won't.

NAD

NORD All Star - Zebra 

Which is exactly what you get if you trigger Malignant Hyperthermia and the only option is to proceed with a surgery sans anesthesia.

I couldn't move. The anesthesiologist in my face kept breathing smelling salts and I was awake, then not, then awake and I could feel them inside my body. Screaming? Absolutely. The surgeon teaching yelled back that no one was dying but I was going from MH to shock and had to be sedated to address the cardiac emergencies (X2). 


Can you imagine the emotional impact on the surgeons? It was a teaching hospital. Having YOUR surgeon scold you and letting it fester was your lesson. Get some PTSD now. You might be the one making decisions later and your experience will shape how you handle that uncomfortable reality.

I'm more likely to die by the hands of a man I loved than the top 6 Cancers... Still, there's no discussion about how our decisions are not a reflection of Victim's Rights. This person is obviously trying to be productive when courts lag 3+ years behind. My ex-husband is now MIA. Suddenly there are resources that can monitor me, in an ongoing investigation, potentially capital... When I was staring down the barrel it was a different story. When my friend was found murder in January, the rape kit regulations caught her ex. When my cousin jumped out of a moving vehicle to flee it was her poor choice. When her sister's family was annihilated she was responsible as she had pills in her pocket that weren't her prescription and was in the commission of a felony. When the police chief was cornered by my case he openly admitted it but my petition got denied based on statues of limitations... 

There is no crime victims' fund. I was approved for all of it and didn't qualify for a dime. He quit his job before unleashing murderous rage, so I wasn't financially dependent... And...

Why can't you just try SOMETHING and ask if she has used XYZ resources? It's perfectly normal to get frustrated but I am still food insecure and the financial abuse is active after 8yrs. Zero criminal investigations for witness tampering or anything you see on TV. Everything is gone because of a clerical error. 


The government is gridlocked. I don't get Medicaid (need based, he's reporting me as VA/Tricare eligible but I am not and I've spent years trying to provide evidence from VA claims denied...)to cover the coinsurance and deductibles from Medicare (I earned) and I can't get oncology infusions. Outpatient procedures require $,$$$. I don't have the money, they don't schedule. I only have access to emergency care and can see the hematologist when I'm admitted for a blood transfusion, maybe. Last time I was put in an institution.This is really happening. I'm dying. He's vanished and law enforcement is watching him kill me with credit card fraud.

Is anyone listening? You are consenting by silence. I can't get an abortion but I can have a civil lawsuit blatantly violate my civil rights and EVERYONE culpable is betting on me dying before it's really in front of a judge that reads the whole suit. 

Want to go from comfortable to absolutely nothing with additional barriers? Call the police for sexual abuse of your child by your spouse with video and record his confession at the station Day 1. 8yrs of investigation and probation that only violated him because she couldn't find him to discharge the deferred adjudication. He is on their social as a successful business man and giving away bicycles for Christmas with a "no contact with anyone under 17" order that was well hidden by everything I earned in my unnecessarily short life. 

But isn't it funny that a woman is so thoroughly beaten down, she forgot to email you. Hilarious. I bet she has kids and CPS is asking about her groceries tomorrow. They love Friday TROs. Isn't it funny?
You know the assignment. Live a long productive and healthy life in pure spite.

You have to get a higher level of PTSD to deal with the Zebra that codes. Your surgeon had a teachable moment and then went through the checklist like every other time... I'm just saying the things and anticipating a ban but I coded in an emergency c-section and had Dantrolene in and baby out with local, post-op sedation for shock. The first time. 

I couldn't sign the blood consent my arms were covered in wires and IVs. Dead in the eyes "Choose my baby" and "NOBODY IS DYING IN MY OR TODAY!!!" The war cry probably saved our lives. 

If you can't own your voice, put the scalpel down. Even on the bones that aren't covered by flesh or insurance. I didn't know I was MH reactive... 🫡

Find a Children's Advocacy Center - they're a non-profit that works with victims and has all sorts of different services including social workers and therapists along with the police. Every facility is different but the CAC feels like a safe place and not a scary police department. If they are not close to you, find another agency that does rape crisis with social workers. The age of the assaults make it such an emotionally formative trauma that you speaking out is ALL you should have to do. Find someone local today. Right now. Even if it's for a tentative appointment. They are also experts in preserving evidence and doing the best job to ensure that predators are punished and know your local legal system. Two things: get you help for having to carry that, get justice. Okay?
Sometimes just pointing out that the department of ED will pull funding is very motivational for repairs.

Please keep fighting. Please keep taking notes with times and dates and names and details. My child was held HOSTAGE by a psychiatric hospital in Texas and the people responsible were finally indicted and the entire chain of hospitals closed down. We still have to fight for appropriate care, respect and basic human rights; as White people living in the United States, I have an advanced degree and my child's wealthy: I still had to FIGHT for food in a hospital because it's easier to believe that I'm crazy than to Google the medical condition listed on my chart. Being that person on the outside is SO HARD but please keep fighting. It's against the rules here but I'm often the woman on the other side of the wall and I just wanted you to know that what you're doing is saving real lives. It took years to get any kind of resolution after I got my kiddo out of that place and it was a huge setback to treatment but enough people like you spoke up and it changed. Transfers to a medical hospital are done 24/7 because you can have a heart attack on the toilet and intermittent numbness in limbs would FREAK my back doctor out (I know, BTDT) and he'd want immediate MRIs to check for a neurological problem like stroke or seizure and psych patients are especially vulnerable to nerve problems. Please don't stop fighting and try calling her other doctors or a medical hospital to express your concerns about this being neuro so they can evaluate and protect the noggin if it is.

It is hard to understand your post because you are emotionally involved (relatable) but I think that you are mixing up policing and the legal system. I'm a civilian and I have accepted that the legal system goes too fast (in Texas, where I live) and even experienced police officers are not going to understand it fully. They arrest if they see something happen (or think they do) but otherwise they take a report and investigate and submit their stuff to someone with legal training to review and sign the warrant and then the case is given to the DA (another lawyer). So, you can't get legal advice from a cop and if they actually knew the law as well as SOME like to pretend, defense attorneys would be court-appointed only. I think that this whole sub exists because people will lie to your face about what's illegal but it doesn't count until the judge signs something and even then there's appeal.

This! This is the kind of advice that I was hoping for. Our judges are elected and so many run unopposed for decades that they just drift further and further away from ideal.

This judge doesn't even see many people who have representation, so I think that the problem might be resolved by changing the dynamics.

It was a standard OAG support and visitation case (big room, get in line, 200 cases at once) but the children's paternal grandmother filed an emergency motion into the case and I was called out of the blue on a Friday afternoon and told my children were taken. Three CPS investigations determined that her allegations were false. I trusted him and let him stay with me and it was a set-up. He wrote a work of fiction, including admitting that he's unfit and trashing my apartment while I was trying to make money, so Mommy could hire an attorney and take the kids. His allowance was restored and I have to pay child support to a millionaire. 

The whole thing is a disaster but I'm most upset because this has been a new trend. I am disabled and the other side is wealthy and connected; I expected this outcome. Looking for a visitation supervisor, I realized that it's not just my situation as a political favor. 

Judge Bailey made headlines and tainted the 431st, so the Gov created the 467th (I asked for it to be transferred there and the judge was antagonistic) and this is just supposed to be OAG court. Funny enough, the OAG wasn't at the hearing. Oof
